name: Solo Support Workspace
description: Four-agent customer support vertical for solo founders and small teams (2-5 people) running their own support. Head of Customer Support owns the shared support-context.md (product map, tone, SLAs, VIPs, routing). Inbox triages and drafts replies. Help Center turns resolved tickets into KB articles and broadcasts shipped features to requesters. Success & Retention runs onboarding, account health, renewal outreach, churn saves, QBRs, and expansion nudges. Every external tool (inbox, tracker, billing, usage analytics) flows through Composio - no per-tool configuration. Drafts only - the founder approves every send.
